ns2:section.sectionText: Accel Intermed French II, 4 hours. This course is designed for students planning to continue their study of French beyond the 4th semester and possibly major or minor in French. In order to expand French skills, including literary and cultural knowledge, we will concentrate on a grammar review combined with an introduction to literary analysis. This Discovery section concentrates largely on French literatures and cultures outside of France. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman class standing.
